Looking for an innovative way to connect with new
students on campus, the Campus Ministry developed
Freshman Survival Kits, or FSKs, combining the
universal love of free stuff with their desire to tell
others about Jesus.
And 12 years later, that simple idea continues to
grow. This year alone, over 27,300 FSKs, containing
evangelistic materials and novelty items, were
shipped to campus ministry teams across the nation.
F R E S H M A N S U RV I VA L K I TS 1
More than 1 million Freshman Survival Kits (FSKs)
containing Bibles, books, water bottles, highlighters,
and a downloadable music card packaged in a laundry
bag have been distributed on campuses since 1996.
Campus Crusade for Christ created the Freshman
Survival Kits to provide every college student with
the opportunity to know Christ.
KITS PROVIDE CONNECTIONS TO FRESHMEN

a friendly and low-pressure opportunity to talk to
students about God. When combined with spiritually-
